source_refs.note: Topic 13.11.2 with the Interesting Information box, printed page 301.

blocks.text: HOCl and OCl⁻ are effective disinfectants, but HOCl is more effective due to its neutral charge. The neutral charge of HOCl allows to penetrate the cell walls of micro-organisms easily. Essential cellular components such as proteins and lipids are oxidized by HOCl and OCl⁻, which disrupt the cell function leading to cell death. HOCl and OCl can oxidize and inactivate enzymes that are crucial for survival and replication of bacteria.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Nucleic acids (DNA and RNA) can be oxidized by HOCl and OCl⁻ and thus preventing bacteria from replicating and vital cellular functions.
